items.a: It's a used vehicle imported from Japan, then prepared for sale here. Japanese cars are typically well-maintained with low mileage, so a reconditioned unit gives you near-new quality at a considerably lower price than a brand-new import.

items.a: We do. We work with all major banks in Bangladesh and can guide you through the paperwork and approval process. Use the estimator above for a rough monthly figure, then message us for a bank-confirmed quote.

items.a: We handle the import and registration process for you, so you receive a road-ready car. We'll walk you through every document and cost involved before you commit.
Every car comes with warranty coverage, plus after-sales support and maintenance. You can reach us on WhatsApp any time, including outside showroom hours.
items.q: What happens after I buy — is there a warranty?

items.a: Yes. Send us photos and details of your current vehicle on WhatsApp and we'll give you a valuation, which can go straight towards your next car.
